ex.t: In the past people wrote letters.

title.en: used to + infinitive for past habits and states

explain.ko: 과거의 반복된 습관이나 지금은 달라진 상태는 used to + 동사원형으로 말합니다. 부정은 didn't use to, 질문은 Did you use to ...?입니다. 지금은 아니라는 느낌이 있어서 'not any more'과 자주 함께 씁니다.
explain.en: Use used to + base verb for past habits and states that are no longer true. Negative: didn't use to. Question: Did you use to ...? It suggests the situation has changed, so it goes well with 'not any more'.

head: 표현 / Pattern
예 / Example
rows: I used to play football every day.
He didn't use to wear glasses.
Did you use to live here?
I used to live there. I don't live there any more.

notes.en: Use it for past habits and states that are not true now.

notes.ko: 부정·질문에서는 use to (d 없음): didn't use to, Did you use to ...?
notes.en: In negatives and questions it is use to (no d): didn't use to, Did you use to ...?

notes.ko: 한 번 일어난 일에는 쓰지 않습니다: Last year I went to Paris.
notes.en: Do not use it for one-time events: Last year I went to Paris.
